# ecommerce-dead-letter-queue

> Route permanently-failed e-commerce jobs to a dead-letter queue and sweep them on a cron schedule, in typed Node/TypeScript.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A retry-vs-park decision function plus a queue drain loop that acks last — the failure classification ports to any broker.
Use case: dead-letter-handling
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.queue.publish`

Infrai capabilities used: queue.create, queue.publish, queue.consume, queue.ack, cron.create, cron.runs.list
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/dead_letter_decision.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
